sloka: सम्भग्नाः पादपाश्चैमेक्षिपतेहासुरीं तनुम् ।समन्तादाद्योजनं पूर्णमाश्रमं मामकं यदि ॥४-११-५४॥।।
transliteration: sambhagnāḥ pādapāścaimekṣipatehāsurīṁ tanum ।samantādādyojanaṁ pūrṇamāśramaṁ māmakaṁ yadi ॥4-11-54॥।।

translations.english: 'Whoever has broken the trees all over this forest and has thrown the demon's body will not survive if he enters within a radius of one yojana of my hermitage.
